origin.description: Split the rows into named groups.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Named shares, at least two. They are rescaled to sum to 1.

origin.details: Rows are shuffled with sample.int, then cut at the cumulative shares. A message is written when the shares are rescaled.
origin.example:
set.seed(1)
part <- resample_partition(mtcars, c(test = 0.3, train = 0.7))
cat(length(as.integer(part$test)), length(as.integer(part$train)), "\n")
